lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance pixel clusters distributed in semi-linear horizontal patterns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear regions of slightly higher intensity that bisect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.
